summary.text: Cleave Simpson, a Republican, represents District 6 in the Colorado State Senate, where he is Minority Leader; his official legislative profile lists his occupation as farmer/rancher.

paragraphs.text: According to his 2024 campaign website, he was first elected in November 2020 to represent Senate District 35 and became the District 6 senator after redistricting.

The same 2024 campaign page says he graduated from the Colorado School of Mines in 1984 and Alamosa High School in 1979, and that he returned to Alamosa and the San Luis Valley in 2014 to help operate the family farming and ranching operations.
The page also said he had been general manager of the Rio Grande Water Conservation District since 2016.
